description: Reusable vertical time grid used internally by day and week views. Renders date columns with hour slots, all-day event row, overlapping event layout, drag-and-drop, and resize handles with JS interop. Accessibility: the slots share one roving tab stop (Up/Down a slot, Left/Right a column, crossing a resource column before the next day) and events are role=button. An EventTemplate must not contain its own focusable element.

parameters.name: Dates
parameters.description: Dates to display as columns.

parameters.name: Events
parameters.description: Events to display.

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description: Resources for grouping columns.

parameters.name: SlotDuration
parameters.description: Duration of each time slot in minutes.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether events are read-only (no drag/resize).

parameters.name: OnSlotClick
parameters.description: Fires when a time slot is clicked.

parameters.name: SelectedDate
parameters.description: The selected day. The matching column gets tm-scheduler-timegrid-col--selected.

parameters.name: SelectedEvent
parameters.description: The selected event. The matching event gets aria-current and tm-scheduler-timegrid-event--selected.

parameters.name: SelectedEventChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the user selects an event.

parameters.name: OnEventClick
parameters.description: Fires when an event is clicked.

parameters.name: OnEventChanged
parameters.description: Fires when an event is moved or resized.

parameters.name: OnAnnounced
parameters.description: Fires with the sentence a move or a resize should announce. The scheduler owns the one live region.

parameters.name: OnSlotContextMenu
parameters.description: Fires when right-clicking on a time slot.

parameters.name: OnEventContextMenu
parameters.description: Fires when right-clicking on an event.

parameters.name: EventTemplate
parameters.description: Optional custom event template.

parameters.name: HideTimeGrid
parameters.description: When true, hides the hourly time grid body (only header and all-day row are shown).

parameters.name: Today
parameters.description: Today in the display zone. The matching column gets tm-scheduler-timegrid-col--today.

parameters.name: HighlightWeekends
parameters.description: When true, Saturday and Sunday columns get tm-scheduler-timegrid-col--weekend.

parameters.name: AllDayEventStyle
parameters.description: Paint of an all-day event. Tinted adds tm-scheduler-event--tinted.

parameters.name: WorkDayStart
parameters.description: First minute of the working day. With ShowFullDay false it is the first rendered hour.

parameters.name: WorkDayEnd
parameters.description: Last minute of the working day.

parameters.name: ShowFullDay
parameters.description: When false the grid shows only the working hours. Default true.

parameters.name: HighlightOffHours
parameters.description: When true, hours outside the working day are tinted. Default false.

parameters.name: ScrollToTime
parameters.description: When set, the grid scrolls this time to the top of the visible track after the first render. Null does not scroll.

parameters.name: ShowNowIndicator
parameters.description: When true today's column draws the current-time indicator. Default true.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: Display zone for the current-time indicator. Null uses the injected clock's local zone.

parameters.name: HideDateHeaders
parameters.description: When true the date header row is not rendered. A Day view with resources sets it.

parameters.name: ResourceHeaderTemplate
parameters.description: Replaces the default resource header (initials avatar, name and resource type).

parameters.name: ShowEventResource
parameters.description: When true a timed event names its resource under the title.

examples.title: Time grid for a single day
examples.code: <TmSchedulerTimeGrid Dates="@(new List<DateOnly> { DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.Today) })" Events="@_events" SlotDuration="30" OnSlotClick="@HandleSlotClick" OnEventClick="@HandleEventClick" />
